import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a scatter plot with regression line
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', palette='deep', alpha=0.7)
sns.regplot(data=df, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', scatter=False, color='gray', ci=None)

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Megapixels vs Price of Digital Cameras')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type & 4K Video Capability', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
